exposure: Feeding during the first months of life
Casein hydrolysates with Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG (LGG)
Type of feed received as treatment (casein hydrolysates or casein hydrolysates with Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG (LGG))
outcome: Time to cow's milk allergy (CMA) tolerance recovery
cohort: 245 infants with CMA (125 IgE-mediated and 120 non-IgE-mediated)
finding: Tolerance acquisition is faster in non-IgE-mediated CMA subjects and in those who received casein hydrolysate with LGG.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with later tolerance (HR = 0.78; 95% CI: 0.58-1.05).
